calls.searchPlaceholder: Search by owner, name or phone number

party.hint: Choose one: a call is logged against a customer or a lead, never both.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.subtitle: Scheduled and held customer meetings.
meetings.startHint: Your current location will be recorded when the meeting starts.
meetings.started: Meeting started; your location was recorded.
meetings.endHint: Your current location will be recorded to verify the meeting location.
meetings.ended: Meeting ended; the location was verified.

location.title: Location verification
location.verifiedBody: The employee remained within {radius} meters of the meeting's starting location.
location.changedBody: The employee's ending location was {metres} meters from the meeting's starting location.
location.unreliable: Location could not be reliably verified
location.unreliableBody: The reported GPS accuracy was too low to confidently verify the {radius}-meter radius.
location.inProgress: The meeting is in progress: its end location will be checked against the start when it ends.
location.unavailable: Location verification unavailable for this meeting.
location.notStarted: Not started yet: the location is recorded when the meeting starts and ends.

errors.denied: Location permission is required to start or end a meeting. Allow location access for this site in your browser, then try again.
errors.unavailable: Unable to determine your location. Check that location services are on, then try again.
errors.timeout: The location request timed out. Move to where your device can get a GPS fix, then try again.
errors.unsupported: Location is not supported by this browser, so the meeting cannot be started or ended here.

map.label: Map of the meeting's start and end positions with the {radius} m radius around the start.
map.within: The end position is within {radius} m.
map.outside: The end position is outside {radius} m.
map.not-configured: The map is not available: Google Maps is not configured.
map.failed: The map could not be loaded.

visits.title: Site visits
visits.subtitle: Planned and completed site visits with GPS check-in.
visits.checkedOut: Checked out; the visit is completed.
